capex_override.reason: From FY2025 Symbotic reports capex only on this combined line (PPE purchases plus capitalized internal-use software), which no engine candidate tag reads, so the annual capex fact is absent and the engine gated the run. The combined line is the filing's own capex definition (it is the line subtracted in the 10-K free-cash-flow reconciliation; FY2024 comparative on the same line is $44,374 thousand vs the $42,237 thousand PPE-only tag the engine captured). The override fills only the missing FY2025 period and does not replace any filed value.
capex_override.source: Symbotic FY2025 Form 10-K (filed 2025-11-24), consolidated statements of cash flows / free-cash-flow reconciliation, year ended September 27, 2025: 'Purchases of property and equipment and capitalization of internal use software development costs' $79,030 thousand

moat_against: Extreme customer concentration — Walmart and GreenBox account for the vast majority of backlog and revenue
No proven through-cycle profitability: GAAP net income was still negative in FY2025 and only thinly positive in FY2026 quarters, with negative historical ROIC
Heavy stock-based compensation ($183.9M in FY2025, $234.5M TTM per ttm.py) is a real, recurring dilution cost
Competition from AutoStore, Ocado and legacy integrators in adjacent fulfillment use cases; technology lead must be re-earned
Project business: revenue and cash flow are lumpy by deployment timing, and customer capex cycles drive starts
moat_for: Proprietary end-to-end case-picking system (AI software + robot fleet + modular storage) with clear lead in US retail distribution centers
Installed systems designed for 25-30yr life and embedded in the distribution center itself — replacement means redesigning the facility, so switching costs are very high
Walmart anchor deployment across its regional distribution centers under a long-term master agreement, plus GreenBox (SoftBank JV) warehouse-as-a-service channel
$22.5B contracted backlog at Q3 FY2026 giving multi-year revenue visibility
Growing recurring software and operations-services revenue (Q3 FY2026 software +57% YoY, services +49% YoY per earnings reports)
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow: proprietary integrated warehouse-automation system with 25-30yr installed life and very high switching costs once embedded, anchored by Walmart across its regional distribution centers and a $22.5B backlog, but customer concentration is extreme, GAAP profitability is only just emerging, SBC is large, and AutoStore/Ocado/legacy integrators contest adjacent use cases.
name: Symbotic Inc.
one_liner: High-growth warehouse-automation leader, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% on the normalized median base (weighted IRR 12.4%, weighted IV@15 $28.44 vs $37.90 price); the TTM base would say Tier S but its OCF is inflated by customer prepayments, so the method range is D to S, confidence is low, and the verdict is sized to the conservative end — clears 15% at $28.44 or below.
